restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมชัยพฤกษ์
text: I honestly don't understand why it's getting such a low rating. The staff was wonderful to me. The dentist who treated me spoke excellent English. They took some x-rays, but for some reason, they didn't charge me, even though I didn't necessarily need them. Anyway, the quote was a great price. It was a filling, but I didn't do the procedure because the available resin didn't match my teeth's color. They didn't charge me for the evaluation. And they were very honest throughout the process. I recommend them. 09-2025

text:
Came for a cleaning and to remove the wire on the back of my teeth.

After the wire was removed the dentist told me I was all done. I asked, “aren’t you going to do the cleaning?”. She said oh yeah and the hygienists proceeded to clean my teeth for less than 5 minutes.

Charged me $80

I don’t think they expected me to return as they didn’t even bother taking my number. Just my name and age. Probably explains the poor service…

text:
Make children scream like never before! And don't stop until they can't breathe! I highly recommend this place. They try to give gifts to children, but they really aren't happy to receive them. The doctor isn't gentle or soft, and sometimes he's moody with children because he screams. It's not a place for children! Treatment of a child's tooth with a crown costs 4,500 baht.
This clinic is clearly not for children. The pediatrician behaves inappropriately. When a child is screaming madly, she doesn't even react and continues drilling until the child is choking! And when you criticize her, she freaks out! I highly recommend this clinic for children. Their gifts are no fun for children. It would be better to find kinder pediatricians who are more understanding of children!
Root canal treatment of a baby tooth with a crown costs 4,500 baht.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมชัยพฤกษ์
text: My 8-year-old son went to get a root canal and crown from a doctor who claims to be a pediatrician. He cried, his eyes swollen, and screamed because he was scared and had trouble breathing through his nose due to the mucus and pain. The doctor didn't care and just wanted to get it done. He had no expertise in treating children and acted displeased during the treatment. If you're a pediatrician, you need to understand children better. Parents who take their children to the dentist, be careful about the doctor.
